I contribute to the development of a new in-situ soil imaging method to dynamically, integratively, and non-invasively monitor the activity of roots and soil invertebrates. I explore the potential offered by this innovative method to study the spatio-temporal organization of soil activity across ecological, spatial, and temporal scales.
